training_config.horizon_curriculum: Six equal stages: 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128 steps, each capped at the requested horizon
training_config.learning_rate_schedule: Cosine from initial learning rate to 10% of initial
training_config.validation_windows: Two windows per selected trajectory: initial settling, plus 3 s horizontal/circle, 2 s vertical, 5 s hold, or 1 s dynamic release
training_config.loss: equal nonempty moving/stationary group means; reference displacement threshold 0.5 mm

snapshot.selection: lowest validation_loss at frozen in-progress snapshot
